description: Let Kai's outbound calls show a number the person already owns (their cell or an old main line) instead of a KaiCalls line, so people recognize who is calling. A verification call goes to that number and returns a code; the person answers and types the code on the keypad. Then get_own_caller_id confirms it. Ownership is proven only by that call. US and Canada numbers. Business owner only. Charges nothing. Callbacks to the shown number reach that phone, not Kai. use_by_default (default true) shows it on every call unless make_call asks for caller_id 'business_line'. Starting a new number replaces the old one.

phone_number.description: The number to show, e.g. +19085551234. It must ring a phone the person can answer.

use_by_default.description: Show it on every call unless a call asks otherwise (optional, default true).

name: start_own_caller_id
